findings.current: Jang Taebo has lived anonymously near Jeongyang for more than ten years, refuses commissions, and now agrees to personally forge Taekyung's weapon after seeing his enormous supply of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron.
findings.defect: The active state drops Taekyung’s unresolved promise to protect Jang Taebo’s location and explain the situation to Jin Wikyung.
findings.rationale: This remains an active obligation after Chapter 168 and is explicitly preserved in the checkpoint continuity summary.
findings.replacement: Jang Taebo has lived anonymously near Jeongyang for more than ten years, refuses commissions, and now agrees to personally forge Taekyung's weapon after seeing his enormous supply of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron; Taekyung promised to keep Jang Taebo's residence secret and must explain the matter to Jin Wikyung.
findings.source: Durable state, active_continuity entry for Jang Taebo’s residence

findings.defect: The Quest UI label sits outside the System blockquote even though it is part of the same uninterrupted game panel.
findings.rationale: Binding formatting requires all consecutive System notices, labels, and fields to remain inside one blockquote window headed by System.

findings.defect: The three reactions use periods instead of the required ellipsis character.
findings.rationale: The packet otherwise follows the specified typographic convention of using the single ellipsis character.
findings.source: Chapter 167, immediately after Jang Taebo spits out the He Shou Wu

findings.defect: Raw HTML break tags introduce an unnecessary formatting difference into the English reading copy.
findings.rationale: A standalone bold line already isolates the flag text cleanly in Markdown; the HTML tags are extraneous and inconsistent with the surrounding chapters.

findings.current: its current Guild Leader is Jang Taebo’s Disciple.
findings.defect: The ordinary relationship noun “Disciple” is incorrectly capitalized.
findings.rationale: “Disciple” is neither an established title nor a mapped proper term in this context.
findings.replacement: its current Guild Leader is Jang Taebo’s disciple.
findings.source: Chapter 165, Wipeng’s warning about the Ironcraft Guild

findings.current: In other words, it was a blacksmiths’ Guild.
findings.defect: The generic noun “guild” is incorrectly capitalized.
findings.rationale: Only the formal organization name “Ironcraft Guild” requires capitalization.
findings.replacement: In other words, it was a blacksmiths’ guild.
findings.source: Chapter 165, explanation of the Ironcraft Guild

summary: The reading copies are broadly consistent in voice, terminology, and continuity. One unresolved secrecy hook is missing from active state, and there are several minor capitalization and System/Markdown formatting inconsistencies.
